ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB=60\,cm$, point C is the midpoint of line segment AB, and point D is a point on line segment AB with the ratio of the lengths of AD to DB being $2\colon 1$. What is the length of CD in $cm$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=60\,cm$, and point C is the midpoint of line segment AB,\\
therefore, $BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=30\,cm$,\\
therefore, $CD=BC-BD=30-20=\boxed{10}\,cm$.
